title: Onion Jam and Gruyere Quiche
subtitle: with slow-cooked onions and thyme
description: A buttery tart case filled with slowly cooked onion jam, garlic, thyme and melted Gruyere cheese.

steps.text: Process the flour, salt and cold cubed butter in a food processor. Add the cold water and a few drops of lemon juice and process to a smooth dough. Wrap in cling film and refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Roll the dough to 3 mm thick and line the tart tin. Bake for 15 minutes until it just starts to turn golden.
Heat oil over medium-low heat. Add the thinly sliced onions, sliced garlic, thyme and bay leaf and cook for about 1 hour, stirring occasionally, until the onion is browned, soft and jam-like.
Add the wine and keep cooking until all the liquid is absorbed. Season with salt and pepper and cool. Remove the thyme stem and bay leaf.
Mix the onion mixture with the Gruyere and fill the part-baked tart case. Bake for 50 minutes until the quiche is browned. Serve hot.
